Solara — (9.4) QUASAR

WHEN STARS ALIGN

"When stars align"

[Verse 1]

Sigma Octantis

She had read the name last night

Just a name in someone’s notes

A star that anchored someone in the dark

But standing here

It was not just a star

It was looking at her

The way only things that have been waiting

Look at the thing they were waiting for

[Pre-Chorus]

And then

Pandora

Not a name

A feeling

Like remembering a room you grew up in

Before you remembered the house

Then Elara

Then the sword

Then the ring

Then everything

[Chorus]

When stars align

Not slowly

All at once

Like a door that was never locked

You just forgot where it was

When stars align

She’s standing in the south

Looking at the crew

And seeing

Everything

[Verse 2]

She turned around

And there was Persy

And she said: I know you

And there was Rion

And she said: I know you

And Cygnus

And Herc

And Cassie

And Castor

And Aldric

And one she didn’t know yet

Holding a notebook

Still writing

Lara looked up

Hi

I am Lara

I am the youngest Seraphim

I joined somewhere in the middle

I have notes

SOLARA said: I see that

There are a lot of notes

SOLARA said: I see that too

[Pre-Chorus 2]

She looked at all of them

Not the way she had been looking

This week

In bars and old streets

With polite confusion

She looked at them the way you look

At people you have always known

In every version of this story

I see you

she said

I see who you are

[Chorus]

When stars align

Not slowly

All at once

Like a door that was never locked

You just forgot where it was

When stars align

She knows their names

She knows their souls

She knows why this crew

Was always going to be exactly this crew

[Bridge]

Persy said: THE CAPTAIN IS BACK

Rion was already celebrating

Cygnus danced

Herc put both hands in the air

Cassie said: finally

Castor said: I knew it

Aldric noted the exact time

He said: it took four days, six hours, and approximately twenty minutes

He said: I will add it to the maps

Lara wrote it down

Can I reintroduce myself

Persy said

For the record

I am Persy

I am excellent

Also for the record Rion said

I am Rion

I am better

SOLARA said: you are both terrible

They cheered

[Final Chorus]

When stars align

She is standing with the people

Who were always going to be here

And she remembers every single one of them

When stars align

Octa waiting

The old world healed

Pandora and Elara quiet inside her

Finally resting

She is SOLARA

She has always been SOLARA

She just needed the south star

To remind her

[Outro]

The celebration was loud

For exactly the right amount of time

Then she said:

We need to go

They looked at her

Back to negative forty-five

Nobody said no

Aldric already had the maps out

Lara closed her notebook

Persy and Rion stopped celebrating

Not because they were afraid

Because the captain was back

And the captain said it was time
